clusters.label: Covid
clusters.title: A pandemic unfolds through the eyes of the scientists who tracked it. These projects collect, translate, and give form to work that would otherwise stay invisible. A global crisis becomes something we can look at.

clusters.label: Affinity
clusters.title: Something quiet draws researchers toward one another. These projects visualize the hidden ties that bind them into productive, creative communities. A way of seeing what holds a community together.

clusters.label: Représentation
clusters.title: Researchers cite and gather in shifting constellations. These projects turn conferences into networks of authors linked by their shared vocabulary. A field takes shape before your eyes.

clusters.label: Peirce Manuscripts
clusters.title: Charles S. Peirce filled thousands of pages with hand-drawn diagrams. These projects digitize, transcribe, and interpret them with vision-language models. Machines learn to read what only scholars once could.

clusters.label: Analogous City
clusters.title: Aldo Rossi collaged the city of memory in 1976. These projects restage it across archives, museums, installations, and data-driven study. A modernist monument returns for the digital age.
